rag.text:
Test: TC-99002 — Journey — Text custom field visible across parent and child records
Priority: High | Status: Reference | Type: Manual
Folder: /Neutral/Journey - Field propagation
Labels: neutral-golden, journey

Steps:
1. Ensure a Text custom field exists for the workspace
   Data: fieldName: Journey Text
   Expected: Field listed as active
2. Create parent record with Text value
   Data: value: Parent-1
   Expected: Parent saved; Text shown in panel
3. Create child record under parent
   Expected: Child create form shows Text default Not set
4. Set Text on child and save
   Data: value: Child-1
   Expected: Child visible; Text correct in tree and panel
5. Open parent detail **Info** section
   Expected: Parent Text value unchanged and correct
